column1: 22811§keen§kiːn§I'm not very keen on Westerners, although my father likes them.§我不是很**喜欢**西部人，尽管父亲很喜欢他们。§
22812§worm§wɜːm§There are two worm gears, one vertical and one horizontal.§有两种**蜗**轮，一种是垂直的，另一种是水平的。§改译文：worm gear 是蜗轮，原译「涡轮」（turbine）用字错，改为「蜗轮」
22813§stiff§stɪf§We felt stiff after a long walk.§走了很长一段路后，我们感觉腿脚**发僵**。§
22814§timber§ˈtɪmbə(r)§Forests are cut down for timber.§森林被砍伐成**木材**。§
22815§profound§prəˈfaʊnd§Globalization effects very profound changes in modern lifestyles.§全球化使现代人的生活方式发生了**深刻**的变化。§
22816§unconcerned§ˌʌnkənˈsɜːnd§Only 22 percent say they are unconcerned about this issue.§只有22％的人称他们**不关心**此事。§
22817§permission§pəˈmɪʃn§Students living in the dorm do not need permission to park their cars.§住宿生（在宿舍停车场）停车无须得到**许可**。§
22818§labour§ˈleɪbə(r)§As a result, 51% of all women aged 14 to 64 are now economically active in the labour market.§结果表明，**劳务**市场上年龄在14到64岁之间的所有女性中，51%的人在经济方面很活跃。§
22819§quota§ˈkwəʊtə§Your sales are always below quota.§你们的销售量总是低于**定额**。§
22820§suspect§səˈspekt§Scientists suspected it to be a comet.§科学家**怀疑**它是一颗彗星。§
22821§deterioration§dɪˌtɪəriəˈreɪʃn§There is a serious deterioration in relations between the two countries.§两国的关系严重**恶化**。§
22822§triple§ˈtrɪpl§As a whole, European countries see forests as performing a triple function: biological, economic and recreational.§整体来看，欧洲国家认为森林在以下**三方面**起到了作用：生物、经济以及休闲娱乐。§

22823§condemn§kənˈdem§Forests offer those condemned to spend five days a week in an urban environment an unrivalled area of freedom to unwind and take part in a range of leisure activities, such as hunting, riding and hiking.§对那些每周五天**被迫**待在城市环境里的人来说，森林提供了一片无比自由的天地，让他们放松放松，参加诸如打猎、骑马、徒步旅行等一系列休闲活动。§改例句：书上主语印成 The police，句意不通，按原文（剑桥雅思讲森林的文章）改回 Forests，并删去多余的 with；改译文：随例句重译，condemned to 是「被迫」

22824§transcend§trænˈsend§The forest policy must transcend national frontiers and generations of people, and it must allow for the inevitable changes that take place in the forests, in needs, and hence in policy.§森林政策必须**超越**国界和世代的界限，必须考虑到森林、需求以及相关政策所发生的不可避免的变化。§

22825§cumulative§ˈkjuːmjələtɪv§The condition appears to result from the cumulative effect of a number of factors, with atmospheric pollutants the principal culprits.§这种情况看上去是由大量因素**日积月累**所导致的，其中大气污染物是罪魁祸首。§

22826§horizontal§ˌhɒrɪˈzɒntl§Gharib and Graff set themselves the task of raising a 4.5-metre stone column from horizontal to vertical, using no source of energy except the wind.§加里卜和格拉夫为自己制定了这样一项任务，除了风以外，不借助其他任何能源，把4.5米高的石柱由**水平**抬高成垂直状态。§

22827§certify§ˈsɜːtɪfaɪ§The council, which was founded in 1996, certifies fisheries that meet high environmental standards, enabling them to use a label that recognizes their environmental responsibility.§成立于1996年的委员会为达到高环境标准的渔场提供**证明**，准许他们使用一种认可他们所承担的环境责任的标签。§
22828§arousal§əˈraʊzl§The physiological arousal declined quickly to the same levels as those of the control subjects.§生理**激发**水平迅速下降到了同受控对象一样的程度。§
22829§addiction§əˈdɪkʃn§For his severe illness he had to fight his addiction to alcohol.§因为病情严重，他不得不戒酒**瘾**。§改译文：原译「戒酒」没译出 addiction（瘾），改为「戒酒瘾」
22830§allege§əˈledʒ§The police alleged that the man was murdered but they have not given proof yet.§警方**宣称**这个人被谋杀了，但是他们还没有给出证据。§
22831§amphibious§æmˈfɪbiəs§The newly built Noah's Ark is a kind of amphibious vehicle.§新建的诺亚方舟是**水陆两用**的运载工具。§
22832§ascend§əˈsend§The air became colder and more rarefied as we ascended.§我们越往上**攀登**，空气就变得越冷越稀薄。§
22833§assert§əˈsɜːt§The arrested offender continued to assert that she was innocent.§被捕的罪犯仍然在**强调**她是清白的。§
22834§assure§əˈʃʊə(r)§The young boy assured us of his ability to solve the problem.§那个小男孩向我们**保证**他有能力解决这问题。§
22835§baffle§ˈbæfl§All of us are baffled why she didn't give us the notice.§我们都很**困惑**她为什么没有通知我们。§
22836§bewilder§bɪˈwɪldə(r)§His sudden change of mood completely bewildered me.§他情绪突然转变使我完全**摸不着头脑**。§
22837§biodiversity§ˌbaɪəʊdaɪˈvɜːsəti§The oilfield engineering threatens one of the world's richest areas of biodiversity.§油田工程对世界上一块拥有最丰富**物种多样性**的地域造成了威胁。§
22838§bud§bʌd§Jasminum mesnyi has the first buds in spring.§野迎春在春天里长出第一批**花蕾**。§
22839§celestial§səˈlestiəl§The moon and the galaxy are all celestial bodies.§月亮和银河都是**天体**。§
22840§combination§ˌkɒmbɪˈneɪʃn§The old man's treatment was a combination of surgery, radiation and drugs.§对那位老人的治疗**结合**了外科手术、放射治疗以及药物治疗。§改译文：原译「集…于一体」拆在两处标不出，改为「结合了」
22841§impact§ˈɪmpækt§Cigarette smoke has the same impact on smokers as it does on non-smokers.§香烟烟雾对吸烟者和不吸烟者的**影响**是一样的。§
22842§renew§rɪˈnjuː§The swift increase of population renewed the demand for building houses quickly and cheaply.§人口的迅速增长**再次**要求加快房屋的建造速度并且降低建筑成本。§改译文：原译「进一步」不是 renew（重新，恢复）的意思，改为「再次」
22843§bow§baʊ§When you're introduced to a stranger, you may simply bow to each other.§当你被介绍给一个陌生人的时候，你们可能只是彼此**点一下头**。§
22844§defeat§dɪˈfiːt§Now both coaches know semifinal defeat could cost them their jobs.§现在双方的教练都很清楚，半决赛**失败**可能会让他们丢掉工作。§
22845§evoke§ɪˈvəʊk§This fragrance evokes the memory of a cool, summer evening.§这种香味**唤起**了我对一个清凉夏夜的回忆。§
22846§flutter§ˈflʌtə(r)§Her heart began to flutter with fear.§她害怕得心**怦怦乱跳**。§
22847§front-line§ˌfrʌnt ˈlaɪn§Decision-making has been forced down in many cases to front-line employees.§很多时候，决策权被迫下放到**第一线**的雇员手中。§
22848§desperate§ˈdespərət§Tom was desperate to find friends with common interests.§汤姆**渴望**结交一些志趣相投的朋友。§
22849§gear§ɡɪə(r)§Single-speed cycles are bikes with no gears.§单速自行车就是没有变速**齿轮**的自行车。§
22850§band§bænd§The drum band will be appearing on stage in the next show.§下一个节目将是鼓**乐队**表演。§
22851§breed§briːd§Rabbits breed very quickly.§兔子**繁殖**得非常快。§
22852§intelligible§ɪnˈtelɪdʒəbl§I have failed to make the sentence intelligible.§我没能把这个句子弄**清楚**。§

22853§essence§ˈesns§Psychologists claimed that the essence of reasoning lies in the putting together of two behaviour segments in some novel way to reach the goal.§心理学家声称，推理的**本质**就在于将两个行为片断用某种全新的方式结合起来，以达到预期的目的。§
22854§predispose§ˌpriːdɪˈspəʊz§Exposure to too much noise may predispose you to a headache.§听了太多的噪音会让你**容易**头疼。§改译文：原译「会让你头疼」漏了 predispose（使易于）的意思，补「容易」
22855§display§dɪˈspleɪ§The windows display postcards and greeting cards designed by women artists for New Year.§橱窗**陈列**着女艺术家们为新年设计的明信片和贺卡。§
22856§retire§rɪˈtaɪə(r)§In this hospital, children under 16 don't need to pay, and the same thing goes for people who have retired.§在这家医院，16岁以下的儿童免费就诊，**退休**人员也可享受同等待遇。§
22857§enlarge§ɪnˈlɑːdʒ§The new headmaster enlarged his office and installed expensive carpet.§新校长**扩充**了他的办公室，并铺上了昂贵的地毯。§
22858§occur§əˈkɜː(r)§Generally, molt occurs at the time of least stress on the birds.§通常，换毛**发生**在小鸟压力最小的时候。§
22859§relate§rɪˈleɪt§That's the office that deals with all matters related to student welfare.§那间就是负责处理所有**有关**学生福利待遇问题的办公室。§
22860§stark§stɑːk§The language barrier presents itself in stark form to firms who wish to market their products in other countries.§对于那些想把自己的产品销售到其他国家的企业来说，语言成了他们**明显**的障碍。§

22861§inform§ɪnˈfɔːm§Fancy Foods wishes to inform the public that pieces of metal have been found in some jars of Fancy Foods Chicken Curry (Spicy).§美食公司希望**告知**大众，在他们生产的一些咖喱（辣）鸡块罐头中发现有金属碎片。§改例句：中文括号改为英文括号
22862§halt§hɔːlt§That country halted most oil exports.§该国**暂停**了大部分的石油出口。§
22863§nerve§nɜːv§The animal's optic nerves are highly regenerative.§这种动物的视觉**神经**有非常强的再生能力。§
22864§deadline§ˈdedlaɪn§If you can't meet a deadline for an essay, you should go and see your lecturers.§如果你不能在**截止日期**前交论文，就应该去找你的老师（说明情况）。§改译文：原译「按时」括不出 deadline（最后期限），改为「在截止日期前」
22865§limb§lɪm§The body is pretty good at self-repair. A strain to a limb, though painful at the time, generally resolves itself.§身体的自我修复功能很强。扭伤**手臂**当时虽然有些疼，但一般都能自我消退。§
22866§sphere§sfɪə(r)§Mary's sphere of interests is very limited.§玛丽兴趣**范围**不广。§改译文：原译「玛丽兴趣不广」没译出 sphere（范围），补「范围」
22867§evolution§ˌiːvəˈluːʃn§The scientist has suggested that evolution of speech went with right-handed preference.§科学家认为，语言的**进化**伴随着使用右手的倾向而产生。§
22868§suitable§ˈsuːtəbl§This medicine is not suitable for children under age 5.§这种药不**适合**五岁以下儿童服用。§
22869§criminal§ˈkrɪmɪnl§The discontent may lead more youths into criminal behaviour.§这种不满情绪可能会导致更多的年轻人走上**犯罪**之路。§

22870§undoubtedly§ʌnˈdaʊtɪdli§The shift of food-production from Europe to regions without farm subsidies will undoubtedly mean more pressure to convert natural habitat into farmland.§**毫无疑问**，粮食生产从欧洲转向没有农业补贴的地区意味着自然栖息地被转为农田的压力日益增大。§
22871§avalanche§ˈævəlɑːnʃ§An earthquake triggered an avalanche.§地震引起一场**雪崩**。§

22872§alienation§ˌeɪliəˈneɪʃn§The creation of healthy social environment must address issues such as poverty, pollution, natural resource depletion, social alienation and poor working conditions.§要营造健康的社会环境，必须解决贫困、污染、自然资源枯竭、社会关系**疏离**以及工作环境恶劣等问题。§
22873§accumulate§əˈkjuːmjəleɪt§The debris that accumulated at the foot of the volcano reached a depth, in places, of 200 feet.§**堆积**在火山脚下的岩屑在一些地方有200英尺厚。§
22874§transmit§trænzˈmɪt§All the documents have been transmitted electronically to the printing centre.§所有文件已经被以电子方式**传送**至印刷中心。§
22875§identification§aɪˌdentɪfɪˈkeɪʃn§Give us the ship's name, its identification number and ocean region.§告诉我们这艘船的名字、它的**识别**号以及所处海域。§改译文：原译「登记号」的「登记」不是 identification（识别）的意思，改为「识别号」
22876§wander§ˈwɒndə(r)§They enjoyed wandering in this old town.§他们喜欢在这个古镇上**闲逛**。§
22877§classical§ˈklæsɪkl§Some architects look back to the classical tradition.§一些建筑师追忆起**古典**的建筑风格。§
22878§abuse§əˈbjuːs§Biometrics may raise thorny questions about privacy and the potential for abuse.§生物测定学可能会引起棘手的隐私问题，也可能导致对此技术的**滥用**。§
22879§fake§feɪk§He's holding the fake credit card, but doesn't dare to use it.§他手里攥着**伪造**的信用卡，却不敢用。§改例句：dares not to use 意思成了「敢于不用」，语法错，改为 doesn't dare to use
